title: ValidationResult
description: Artifact produced by phase-4h-validation (TASK-0073). Output of the deterministic Objective Validation Checklist Engine. Contains pass/fail verdicts for all hard and soft checks, an overall verdict, and revision metadata.

validation_id.description: Unique validation run ID. Format: VAL-{YYYY}-{first 8 chars of plan_hash}.

plan_id.description: ID of the plan (or consensus_plan) being validated.

plan_hash.description: SHA-256 (RFC 8785) of the plan snapshot at time of validation. Used to detect plan mutations between validation and code generation.

verdict.description: Overall verdict. APPROVED: all hard checks pass + no soft check warnings. CONDITIONALLY_APPROVED: all hard checks pass + ≥1 soft check warning. REJECTED: ≥1 hard check failure.

hard_checks.description: Exactly 7 hard check results. All must pass for verdict != REJECTED.

soft_checks.description: Exactly 6 soft check results (3 input_quality + 3 output_quality). Failures produce CONDITIONALLY_APPROVED but do not cause REJECTED.

hard_check_failures.description: List of hard check IDs (HC-01 through HC-07) that failed. Empty when verdict=APPROVED or CONDITIONALLY_APPROVED.

soft_check_warnings.description: List of soft check IDs (SC-IQ-01..03, SC-OQ-01..03) that produced warnings.

revision_count.description: Number of times this plan has been returned to the planner for revision. Incremented by orchestrator on each REJECTED→revise cycle. When this reaches 3, the HITL escalation gate GATE-ESC-001 activates.

confidence_report_ref.description: Artifact ID of the confidence_report from phase-4d-confidence-scoring. Present when phase-4d ran.

revision_history.description: Append-only log of prior validation rounds.

evaluated_value.description: The actual value observed (numeric, boolean, or string) during the check.

expected_condition.description: Human-readable pass condition, e.g., '>= 1' or '!= null' or 'all items present'.

failure_message.description: Present only when passed=false. Precise human-readable explanation of why the check failed.

warning_message.description: Present only when passed=false. Explains the quality gap without blocking the pipeline.
